newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 109.3 in April.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 109.3 in April.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) monthly future inflation gauge (FIG) fell to 109.3 in April from a revised 109.9 the prior week, ECRI said.

Slower growth in civilian employment and industrial materials prices, a dip in the number of purchasing managers reporting slower deliveries and a widening of the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries pulled the gauge lower, ECRI said.
"After a strong rise in March, April's decline in the FIG shows some moderation in the upswing of cyclical leading indicators of inflation," ECRI said.
